note: PATHS ARE THE RUN'S OWN OUT-DIR, spelled abstractly (see the drivers' `<out-root>` argument): the harness writes `story-<state>/<theme>.webp` under whatever root it is given, so each file field names the state's own directory beside the `live-*` ones. Each state is the STORY it was shot from, so a reader reproduces it from the storybook id in the README's own table rather than from a path on the machine that ran it.
